description:
Cause The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat

uses.cardState: as Avatar Kyoshi without summoning sickness
